title: London Big Ben, 5 Euro, City Hall Clocks
descriptionPlain: Description The majestic Big Ben has set the rhythm of London for generations. Guardian of daily rituals, it brings people together in the city’s greatest moments. Now, this iconic symbol finds its place on a silver coin in the prestigious Town Hall Clocks series. Struck from one ounce of pure silver, it reveals Big Ben’s details with remarkable precision and holds a unique fragment of London’s history.
